title: BBK BBK Territory Wayfinder compact result payload v2
description: Closed compact role-specific result payload for `bbk_territory_wayfinder`. Use FULL when material truth cannot fit these fields.

territory_synthesis_ref.description: Territory ID, revision, lifecycle state, durable path, byte count, and SHA-256 when persisted; inline content is permitted for a routine small territory.

local_work_graph_refs.description: Any current territory-local capability, phase, work-unit, and worker-invocation references, or an explicit not-required or not-ready disposition.

outward_impacts.description: Exact implications for the parent, sibling territories, shared contracts, global work graph, assurance, authority, migration, or baseline.

blockers.description: Exact technical, authority, decision, capacity, host-window, interface, or parent-integration blockers.

parent_actions_requested.description: Exact decisions, interface dispositions, integration actions, resynthesis, or planning actions requested from the semantic parent.

residual_uncertainty.description: Explicit bounded uncertainty retained after economic stopping and its consequence, owner, expiry, or reopening trigger.

x-bbk-full-detail-triggers: Consequential assurance or protected-floor exposure requires detail beyond the compact fields.
Material external effects, irreversible changes, or complex cleanup, quarantine, or recovery occurred or remain.
Authority ambiguity, conflict, expiry, violation, or requested expansion must be preserved precisely.
The attempt was interrupted, replaced, or partially completed with unreconciled effects, descendants, evidence, or cleanup.
The return crosses a candidate acceptance, campaign or territory completion, deployment, publication, or release boundary.
The parent explicitly requested FULL detail.
Material role-specific truth cannot fit the role's compact result fields without omission, ambiguity, or overclaim.
